'
77 Live
is a
live album
by Japanese experimental rock band
Les Rallizes Dénudés
. It was recorded in March 1977 before being released on
CD
in 1991.
[
1
]
[
2
]
Background and composition
'
77 Live
is a recording of a Les Rallizes Dénudés concert performed at the Tachikawa Social Education Hall in
Tokyo
on March 12, 1977. The audio was captured
reel to reel
with a singular microphone resulting in an extremely loud, obliterated mix reminiscent of later
noise rock
.
[
3
]
The individual tracks run between 8 and 25 minutes long, a result of the music being almost entirely improvised on stage.
